title: GTA VI PC Release Date and Requirements: What Is Confirmed?
summary: Rockstar currently confirms GTA VI for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S; avoid invented PC dates and requirements.
intro: Searches for GTA VI PC requirements and a Windows launch date are popular, but Rockstar's current official product page lists PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S for the November 19, 2026 release. It does not publish a confirmed PC date or a verified minimum GPU requirement in the material reviewed here. This article separates existing announcements from reasonable questions that remain unanswered.

sections.heading: Console launch details are confirmed
paragraphs: The official GTA VI site displays November 19 and the two current-generation console families. Rockstar's support articles describe pre-load timing, editions and installation space for those platforms. Those are concrete details worth reporting. A speculative PC date posted by a video channel should not be treated as the publisher's schedule simply because previous Rockstar games eventually reached Windows.

sections.heading: There is no official PC specification sheet yet
paragraphs: Claims about an exact NVIDIA GPU, processor, RAM amount, Windows version or recommended SSD capacity are not supported by a Rockstar GTA VI PC requirements announcement as of this review. A powerful computer may eventually be capable of running an announced PC version, but that does not establish the eventual requirements or optimization quality. Avoid upgrading an entire computer based on a fabricated chart.

sections.heading: Console footage does not set PC settings
paragraphs: Rockstar says its August extended look was captured from in-game footage on PlayStation 5. That establishes the source platform for that showcase, not the exact graphical settings a future Windows version would use. A trailer is also edited for presentation and should not be converted into definitive frame-rate claims. Treat resolution and performance comparisons cautiously until reliable direct measurements are available.

sections.heading: Watch for publisher announcements
paragraphs: A legitimate PC launch would be accompanied by clear platform information, purchase availability and technical requirements from Rockstar. Until then, do not trust a supposed official PC installer, leaked activation code or account claiming to sell day-one Windows access. Downloadable files claiming to make the console build run in GameLoop or an unrelated emulator are especially suspicious.

sections.heading: Make sensible PC upgrades independently
paragraphs: If you play PC games now, upgrade based on those games and measurable bottlenecks rather than a future unconfirmed GTA VI specification. Check CPU, GPU, memory pressure, storage and monitor goals using repeatable tests. Buying more RAM or a newer graphics card can be worthwhile for your current library, but it is misleading to claim it is guaranteed GTA VI preparation without official PC information.
